description.value: Sushi Yoi is a casual Japanese restaurant in Burnaby specializing in fresh sushi, sashimi, and aburi-style nigiri alongside classics like tempura and donburi. The restaurant emphasizes high-quality, locally sourced ingredients and offers both dine-in and takeout, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Rosser Avenue corridor. Outdoor seating is noted in OSM, which may allow cyclists to keep an eye on their bikes.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 10m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 86m; stands (8 spaces, covered) at 99m. Total: 22 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is an active Japanese restaurant at 1815 Rosser Ave, Burnaby, matching OSM address and phone. Takeout is confirmed by the website phrase 'choose convenient take-out and delivery.' No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. A hours discrepancy exists: OSM shows open Sunday–Friday but the website lists Monday as closed.
concerns: Hours discrepancy: OSM opening_hours shows open Sunday–Friday (implying Monday open), but website explicitly lists 'Monday: Close'. OSM hours appear outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Takeout availability makes this a plausible cyclist food stop, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website. On-site verification is needed before inclusion.
